hooks.name: accelerator
hooks.reason: Recognizes AMD workload GPUs in a Server's inventory by provider vendor name or by the 1002 PCI vendor id, which a GPU inventory record cannot say by itself.

tasks.name: Check the AMD GPUs' RAS and error records

validations.title: AMD GPU basics
validations.description: Checks that the amdgpu driver brings up every AMD GPU each Server has on PCI, and that every GPU it brings up allocates, fills, and frees memory through the HIP runtime, three times. A Server without an AMD GPU skips both checks.

expectedGpus.title: Expected GPUs
expectedGpus.description: The GPUs the driver must bring up on each Server. Default: the AMD GPUs on its PCI bus, without those passed through to VMs.

checks.title: Driver brings up the GPUs
checks.description: The kernel's KFD topology lists as many GPUs as are expected.

checks.title: HIP probe
checks.description: Every GPU the driver brings up allocates, fills, and frees memory through the HIP runtime, three times.

validations.title: AMD GPU RAS and error records
validations.description: Reads, without changing anything, what the amdgpu driver reports about each Server's AMD GPUs: that RAS is on, the uncorrectable and correctable error counts, and the CPER error records the driver keeps, exported and decoded through AMD SMI. A Server without an AMD GPU skips every check; when the driver keeps a CPER ring for none of its GPUs, the two CPER checks are skipped.

maxCorrectable.title: Correctable errors allowed per GPU
maxCorrectable.description: The correctable errors each GPU may have counted, and the corrected CPER records each GPU with a CPER ring may have written, before the check fails. Default: none; correctable errors are recorded, not judged.

checks.title: RAS is on
checks.description: Every AMD GPU the amdgpu driver drives has a RAS interface whose feature mask is not zero.

checks.title: Error counts
checks.description: No GPU has counted an uncorrectable error; with maxCorrectable, no GPU has counted more correctable errors than that.

checks.title: CPER export
checks.description: AMD SMI exports the CPER records of the driver's CPER ring; no record is a pass.

checks.title: CPER records
checks.description: No exported CPER record is fatal or uncorrected; with maxCorrectable, the corrected records stay within it per GPU. Each record's AFID is decoded and classified.

validations.title: AMD GPU stress
validations.description: Stresses each Server's AMD GPUs with open-source tools in place of AMD's AGFHC: the ROCm Validation Suite (GEMM, power, HBM integrity and bandwidth, PCIe and XGMI bandwidth) against the pass targets AMD ships for the GPU's SKU, an RCCL all-reduce over every GPU, the temperature and throttling while the stress runs, XGMI errors and links, and no new uncorrectable error or fatal CPER record afterwards. The run downloads the declared RVS release and rccl-tests source into a private directory it removes, and installs nothing. A Server without an AMD GPU skips every check.

level.title: Level
level.description: full runs AMD's RVS conf for the GPU's SKU as it ships; quick keeps its actions and targets and shortens how long each runs, as a smoke test. Default: full.

rvsProfile.title: RVS profile
rvsProfile.description: The RVS conf directory to use, such as MI250X or MI300X. Default: the one the GPU's market name, VBIOS, or product name names.

minHbmGBps.title: Lowest HBM bandwidth (GB/s)
minHbmGBps.description: The lowest average bandwidth each babel function may reach on a GPU. Default: none; the bandwidth is recorded, not judged.

minPcieGBps.title: Lowest PCIe bandwidth (GB/s)
minPcieGBps.description: The lowest host-to-GPU bandwidth each pebb action may measure. Default: none; recorded, not judged.

minXgmiGBps.title: Lowest XGMI bandwidth (GB/s)
minXgmiGBps.description: The lowest GPU-to-GPU bandwidth each pbqt action may measure. Default: none; recorded, not judged.

minBusBwGBps.title: Lowest all-reduce bus bandwidth (GB/s)
minBusBwGBps.description: The lowest RCCL all-reduce bus bandwidth over every GPU. Default: none; recorded, not judged.

maxTemperatureC.title: Highest temperature (C)
maxTemperatureC.description: The highest temperature any GPU sensor may report while the stress runs. Default: 95.

maxCorrectable.title: New correctable errors allowed per GPU
maxCorrectable.description: The correctable errors each GPU may add during the stress. Default: none; new correctable errors are recorded, not judged.

checks.title: GEMM throughput
checks.description: RVS gst reaches the GEMM target of every action in the SKU's gst_single.conf on every GPU.

checks.title: HBM integrity
checks.description: RVS mem passes every memory pattern test.

checks.title: HBM bandwidth
checks.description: RVS babel passes; with minHbmGBps, every function's average bandwidth reaches it.

checks.title: PCIe bandwidth
checks.description: RVS pebb passes; with minPcieGBps, every action reaches it.

checks.title: XGMI bandwidth
checks.description: RVS pbqt passes; with minXgmiGBps, every GPU pair reaches it.

checks.title: XGMI links
checks.description: No GPU reports an XGMI error during the stress, and no reported XGMI link is down.

checks.title: Power
checks.description: RVS iet holds the target power of the SKU's iet_stress.conf.

checks.title: RCCL all-reduce
checks.description: rccl-tests all_reduce_perf over every GPU returns no wrong value; with minBusBwGBps, its bus bandwidth reaches it.

checks.title: Temperature and throttling
checks.description: While the stress runs, no GPU sensor exceeds maxTemperatureC and no PROCHOT or thermal throttle accumulator rises.

checks.title: RAS after the stress
checks.description: The stress adds no uncorrectable error and no fatal or uncorrected CPER record; with maxCorrectable, no GPU adds more correctable errors than that.
